description: Population-scale health surveillance, outbreak anomaly detection, metapopulation transmission dynamics (SEIR/Rt), Global Burden of Disease (DALY/PAF) quantification, SDOH vulnerability mapping, and non-pharmaceutical intervention policy optimization.

inputs.name: surveillance_feed
inputs.description: Multi-stream syndromic encounters, clinical lab positives, and wastewater biosensor logs by geocode.

inputs.name: demographic_census
inputs.description: Census age pyramid, population density, stratified contact matrices, and baseline comorbidities.

inputs.name: environmental_telemetry
inputs.description: Air quality index (PM2.5, NO2, O3), heat wave indices, and municipal waterborne pathogen counts.

inputs.name: sdoh_indicators
inputs.description: Area Deprivation Index, poverty thresholds, crowding, housing type, and transit access metrics.

inputs.name: pathogen_parameters
inputs.description: Basic reproduction number R0, serial interval, latent/infectious periods, CFR, and IFR.

inputs.name: intervention_state
inputs.description: Active non-pharmaceutical interventions, mask mandates, contact tracing, and vaccination tiers.

outputs.name: outbreak_alerts
outputs.description: Spatiotemporal anomaly clusters exceeding statistical alert thresholds with geocodes.

outputs.name: reproduction_metrics
outputs.description: Time-varying effective reproduction number (Rt) with 95% credible intervals.

outputs.name: transmission_forecast
outputs.description: Projected compartmental trajectory (Susceptible, Exposed, Infectious, Recovered, Hospitalized, ICU).

outputs.name: burden_assessment
outputs.description: Global Burden of Disease metrics: Years of Life Lost (YLL), Years Lived with Disability (YLD), DALYs, and PAF.

outputs.name: sdoh_vulnerability
outputs.description: CDC SVI composite scores, localized health disparity indices, and high-risk demographic clusters.

outputs.name: public_health_advisory
outputs.description: Actionable containment guidance, resource allocation orders, and targeted vaccination directives.
